title: Greeting cards and dictation sheet
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 1: Common vocabulary: numbers, colours, clothes and shapes
source: Written for arabic/y7 lesson 1 (Greeting cards and dictation sheet (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 1: Bridge: long vowels and greetings. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

head: Not this

rows: قَلَم and قَالَ sound the same
قَلَم (qalam) has a short a; قَالَ (qala) has a long a written with ا

blocks.task: say the Arabic, turn over and check, or play pairs with a partner.

box.title: Write the words your teacher says, with all the harakat

keywords.def: long vowel letters: ا و ي

questions.q: Read and find the long vowel: نُور
questions.a: nur; the long vowel is و (uu)

questions.q: Core: Write a six-line dialogue: salam and reply, how are you and reply, goodbye and reply.
questions.a: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ. وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلَامُ. كَيْفَ حَالُكَ؟ بِخَيْرٍ، وَالحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ. مَعَ السَّلَامَةِ. مَعَ السَّلَامَةِ.

questions.q: Extend: Dictation: سَلَام، نُور، دِين، بَاب. Circle the long vowels.
Stretch: Perform your dialogue with a partner in a breakout room, using the better reply.
questions.a: Fluent dialogue with وَرَحْمَةُ اللّٰهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ

questions.q: The reply to صَبَاحُ الخَيْرِ is:
questions.a: B) صَبَاحُ النُّورِ. Morning greeting, morning reply: صَبَاحُ النُّورِ (morning of light).

questions.q: Which letter makes a long 'ii'? A) ا B) و C) ي
Big question: how do Muslims greet each other, and why does it matter?
questions.a: With as-salamu 'alaykum; Allah tells us to return greetings with better (an-Nisa' 4:86), and it spreads peace.
